nativeBaseline.reference: polite status live region containing authored content and an optional native button close control

library: provide polite live-region and status semantics without moving focus
preserve native button activation for close controls
keep controlled open state authoritative and report close/timeout intent without secretly hiding controlled content
pause finite timeout while pointer hover or keyboard focus remains within the toast
clear timers and listeners on teardown and avoid server-side timers
consumer: author meaningful notification content and accessible names for icon-only close controls
choose finite versus persistent duration based on whether equivalent information or actions remain available elsewhere
own queueing, severity policy, persistence/history, business actions, retries, and translated message text
perform product-specific assistive-technology review where spoken announcement behavior is a support claim

notes: Toast is a status-message composition, not an APG widget pattern.
Automated and DOM assertions establish semantic wiring but do not prove a particular screen reader spoke a message.

The 5000 ms default is a component policy, not a universal WCAG allowance for essential information or actions; consumers must provide persistent or otherwise accessible alternative access when timing would remove the only opportunity.
Manual assistive-technology observations remain pending and must not be inferred from this mapping.
